assumptions.statement: The three scope levels and the three key areas use provisional rough polygons inferred from the announcement's textual extents and approximate areas; official GIS polygons are not yet publicly available.
assumptions.impact: All areas, figures, and metrics are provisional and must be fully recalculated when official polygons are released. Provisional_rough rectangles must not be interpreted as parcel, road redline, or ownership boundaries.

assumptions.statement: Statutory regulatory-plan controls (floor-area ratio, building height limits, building density, green ratio, setbacks, building control lines, road redlines) are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal presents conceptual development-intensity directions only; no statutory control value is asserted. All building-scale conclusions are framework-level and await approved regulatory conditions.
assumptions.recompute_trigger: approved regulatory-plan conditions or official design-brief attachments

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership and land-use rights status are not verified within the publicly available material.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish (拆改留) and renewal actions are methodological design suggestions, not implementation or ownership instructions.
assumptions.recompute_trigger: property survey or cleared ownership data

assumptions.statement: The protection scope and construction-control zones of heritage assets such as the Qinghuayuan station site, and the exact implemented boundary of the Jing-Zhang Heritage Park, are not yet available as GIS layers.
assumptions.impact: Design along the heritage-park ridge and around cultural nodes is directional; building heights and setbacks near heritage assets must be confirmed through heritage impact assessment.
assumptions.recompute_trigger: published heritage-protection scope and building-control-zone GIS layers

assumptions.statement: Underground pipelines, utility capacity, flood-drainage and sponge-city indicators, and municipal constraints are not yet obtained.
assumptions.impact: Municipal and new-infrastructure schemes (utility tunnels, distributed energy, edge computing, sponge city) are conceptual frameworks requiring special municipal studies.

assumptions.statement: Rail station boundaries, bus stops, passenger flows, and slow-mobility gap status are described as a framework from public sources rather than confirmed survey data.
assumptions.impact: Station-integration and slow-mobility stitching designs are directional and must be verified by traffic and station special studies.

assumptions.statement: The overall design area assigned by the maintainer's provisional boundary is 11,412,825.386 m² in EPSG:4548; the three key areas recompute to about 192.9 ha / 104.3 ha / 72.0 ha.
assumptions.impact: Used as the internal consistency baseline; official values supersede after recalculation. Provisional boundaries remain labeled throughout.

assumptions.statement: The three industry test scenarios T1/T2/T3 (SC-04/SC-05/SC-06) have no approved operator, data-collection authorization, or pilot window. Per-scenario admission and rollback records in visual/assets/scenario_test_records.json mark each admission field as frozen / not collected / pending confirmation until authorization is granted; thresholds are reference directions only.
assumptions.impact: The three test scenarios are proposals for piloting, not approved operations; opening requires operator authorization, privacy review, and a human-equivalent service channel. Objection-entry and deletion-proof processes are frozen until the responsible entity is confirmed.
assumptions.recompute_trigger: operator authorization, pilot window and baseline data release
